title: Intracellular ATP delivery to in vitro expanded mouse CD27− γδ T cells
protocol: Prepare antibody mix by adding 25 μL anti-γδTCR antibody (clone UC7, 0.25 mg/mL) into 6.25 mL sterile PBS.
Mix well to achieve a final concentration of 1 μg/mL.
Add 250 μL antibody mix per well in a 24-well plate.
Place the plate into a 37°C incubator and incubate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Euthanize the mouse (C57BL/6J, 6–8 weeks, female or male) according to local ethical policy.
Spray the mouse with 70% ethanol and fix the animal with dissecting pins in a flat styrofoam.
Cut the skin longitudinally along the abdominal midline and open the skin along limbs with scissors.
Harvest the cervical, brachial, axillary, and inguinal lymph nodes.
Place harvested lymph nodes into ice-cold complete RPMI 1640 medium.
Place a 40 μm cell strainer in a petri dish and rinse with sterile PBS.
Transfer the lymph nodes into the cell strainer and grind with a syringe plunger.
Pass 5–10 mL RPMI 1640 medium through the strainer and transfer the medium to a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Add 1 mL complete RPMI 1640 medium to resuspend the pellet and count the cells using hemacytometer.
Adjust the cell concentration to 2 million/mL with pre-warmed culture medium and mix well.
Discard the PBS from the pre-coated 24-well plate.
Add 1 mL of the single cell suspension per well and gently shake the plate to distribute the cells evenly.
Reconstitute ATP vesicles as described.
Use freshly reconstituted ATP vesicles within 2 days after preparation.
Add ATP and control vesicles at indicated concentrations (0, 1, 10, 20 μM).
Mix well after adding vesicles.
Culture lymphocytes for 72 hours in a 37°C incubator.
Observe the culture solution daily.
Add 1 μL Golgi-plug Brefeldin A (BFA, 1000×) per well to block transport processes and incubate for 4 h.
Collect cells from each well into 15 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 150 μL of PBS.
Add 1 μL Fc Blocker per tube, mix well and incubate for 10 min at 4°C.
Prepare diluted Viability dye and Flow antibody mix as described.
Add 2 μL antibody mix per tube and incubate for 20 min at 4°C in the dark.
Wash by 1 mL PBS per tube.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Add 250 μL Fixation Buffer per tube and mix well.
Incubate for 20 min at 25°C in the dark.
Prepare 1× intracellular staining permeabilization wash buffer.
Wash twice with 1 mL of 1× wash buffer per tube.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 150 μL of 1× wash buffer.
Add 0.5 μL anti-mouse IL-17 PE/Cy7 antibody per tube and mix well.
Incubate for more than 2 h at 4°C in the dark.
Wash by 1 mL of 1× wash buffer per tube.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 300 μL of 1× wash buffer.
Filter cell suspension with a 44 μm nylon mesh.
Analyze with Canto flow cytometer.
